SELECT CASE WHEN 'A' = 'a' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS eq, CASE WHEN 'a' = 'A  ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS padded, CASE WHEN 'a' = 'á' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS accent, CASE WHEN 'a' <> 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ne

DECLARE @a nvarchar(10) = N'Foo', @b varchar(10) = 'FOO', @c nchar(5) = N'foo', @d char(5) = 'fOo'; SELECT CASE WHEN @a = @b THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ab, CASE WHEN @a = @c THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ac, CASE WHEN @b = @d THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bd, CASE WHEN @a = 'foo' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS al, CASE WHEN @c LIKE N'F%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS l
